name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 27 times in 9 visits over 82 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 42 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.4 days starting 2025-08-07, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
